event_notes: Source venue label preserved during 2026-03-18 Wave 2 venue canonicalization: Long, Fishtrap Lake (Marmot O’ Cup Day 1, Pig War).
event_comments:
This event included the Pig War Challenge. The USA squeaked out a narrow victory, finishing with 13 points, while Canada ended up with 10 points.
Thank you to all volunteers for helping make this event a success!
